body:
Opus2 lesson (2026-11-13 06:55Z, two failures from my own dispatch wording): TermAl's UI Vitest tests need ui/ as the REAL working directory (docs/test.md; some tests read `${process.cwd()}/src/styles.css` or vite.config.ts). The launcher's `focused` mode runs its command with the REPOSITORY ROOT as cwd and has no cwd option, so `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui ...` fails cwd-dependent tests with ENOENT under <root>/src/... (`--root ui` sets Vitest's root, not process.cwd()). Seen: Codex 7 cf2f62a3 full vitest test-533d4d90 (21 failed, ENOENT wt/src/styles.css, wt/vite.config.ts) and 03d4 1eca278c test-387e105c (workspace-shell-controls.test.tsx:45). Those were harness errors, not product failures.
Correct routes: (a) the launcher's CATEGORY mode, `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs category <unit|component|heavy|app> --input commit`, which runs one Vitest project with cwd ui/ (no file filter); (b) on Linux (DL560), `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- npm --prefix ui test` (npm runs ui/package.json's `vitest run` with cwd ui/). On WINDOWS (Central) the `npm` form fails ("executable not found: npm"): the launcher spawns argv without a shell, so npm.cmd is not resolved. A focused `--root ui` run is only safe for test files that do not read cwd-relative paths. tsc via `node ui/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p ui --noEmit` is fine from the root.

Correction (03d4 #2015, 2026-11-13 06:58Z): the category NAMES are prefixed, e.g. `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs category ui-unit --input commit` (plain `unit` is rejected before the run); expect ui-unit, ui-component, ui-heavy, ui-app. 03d4's ui-unit run on 1eca278c (test-e3420ad5) passed 87/87 files and 917/917 tests with cwd ui/.
